target.statement: TediGAN achieves FID 106.37 for text-to-image generation on the Multi-Modal CelebA-HQ dataset (Table 2).

compute.basis: Training the StyleGAN inversion encoder, text encoder, and generating enough images for FID requires GPU-accelerated training and inference; on CPU this would be prohibitively slow.

blockers: Requires training multiple neural networks (StyleGAN inversion encoder, text encoder) which is impractical on CPU
FID evaluation requires generating a large number of images, which is slow on CPU
Pretrained StyleGAN model and possibly other components may need to be downloaded or trained
title: TediGAN: Text-Guided Diverse Face Image Generation and Manipulation
